answer: Identity rent stops hoarding. You pay rent to keep an identity alive. The rent is 10 units per epoch, due every epoch. Miss a payment and the identity goes dormant. Dormant identities earn nothing. Do real work and you can afford the rent. Don't work and the rent eats your balance. A velvet badge doesn't waive the rent. An orchard of idle clones still pays per tree. Your voyage through the epochs costs rent at every step. 1,000 clones cost 10,000 units per epoch. That's 60,000 units over 6 epochs. A clone must earn more than 10 units per epoch just to break even.
